summary: Review of fixes addressing 3 external review comments from greptile-apps[bot]: (1) OpenBao kustomization changed from ha.enabled=false to ha.enabled=true with replicas=1 so the Helm chart renders the ha.raft.config stanza instead of silently falling back to standalone.config, (2) wait_for_pods in deploy-infra.sh now polls for pod existence before calling kubectl wait to prevent immediate failure when no pods match the label selector, (3) CI job timeout raised from 20 to 40 minutes to give script-level timeouts room to fire and produce diagnostics before the GitHub Actions runner is killed. All three fixes are correct and match the reviewer's suggestions.

tests_checklist.item: E2E Chainsaw test validates all 11 component health checks (unchanged, not in diff)
wait_for_pods polling loop handles deadline expiry with clear error message
CI timeout (40 min) exceeds sum of script-level timeouts (~20 min) plus overhead

code_quality_checklist.item: Comments reference review #1 for traceability (kustomization.yaml:20, deploy-infra.sh:88)
Polling loop follows existing shell conventions (set -euo pipefail, log function)
ha.enabled=true with replicas=1 is the correct Helm chart configuration for single-node Raft
Terminology updated from standalone to single-node Raft in changed files

security_checklist.item: No new secret handling introduced in changed code
No shell injection vectors added (kubectl commands use variables in safe positions)

architecture_checklist.item: Fix correctly addresses silent Raft misconfiguration — ha.raft.config now rendered by Helm chart
Pod existence polling prevents kubectl wait race condition under set -e
CI timeout headroom prevents GitHub Actions runner kill before script diagnostics

dry_yagni_checklist.item: Changes are minimal and targeted — no scope creep

fail_fast_checklist.item: Polling loop has deadline-based timeout with explicit error on expiry
return 1 on timeout instead of silent failure

defensive_checklist.item: kubectl get pods stderr suppressed (2>/dev/null) to avoid noise during polling
grep -q . correctly detects any non-empty output

suggested_improvements: docs/reference/infrastructure/e2e-deployment.md is now stale: references 'standalone mode' and 'ha.enabled: false' (lines 71, 147, 160, 164, 195) but the implementation changed to 'single-node Raft mode' with ha.enabled=true. The timeout-minutes table (line 348) still says 20 but CI now uses 40. Update the documentation to match the new implementation.

The wait_for_pods polling loop and subsequent kubectl wait each use the full configured timeout independently, so the effective maximum wait could be up to 2x the configured value (e.g., 600s for a 300s timeout). This matches the reviewer's suggested fix and is acceptable given the CI timeout headroom, but documenting this behavior in the function's comment block would aid future maintainers.
next_steps: Update docs/reference/infrastructure/e2e-deployment.md to reflect: ha.enabled=true (not false), 'single-node Raft mode' (not 'standalone mode'), timeout-minutes: 40 (not 20), and the new wait_for_pods pod-existence polling behavior.
